study.question: Can independently stepped same-source M17 copies, with explicitly copied initial parameters and the identical supplied batch stream, develop a numerically unequal gradient/Adam/parameter state within calls0..1023? Does the analogous N trace also diverge, and does this instrumentation disturb the uninstrumented M/N validation behavior? Historical M17 AUC0.6152795936767026 becomes0.6149279138846995 in byte-identical replay, while N remains0.6151021885074872; execution succeeds in each case. This study localizes a prospective internal prefix discrepancy, not the historical host-run divergence.
study.hypothesis: A live duplicate computation/accumulation can produce tiny differences in product-role row gradients even from equal model states; the magnitude correction can propagate them to actual Adam moments and eventually parameters. Observed round19 role discrepancies with near-repeat-floor final gradients motivate this hypothesis but do not establish it. Copying initialization and sharing the actual batch object removes initialization/data-order differences within each prospective twin pair. It does not resolve original-run initialization, host environment, or checkpoint selection.

study.proposed_difference: Append a standalone same-source twin trace to the exact M17 base. Deep-copy the model at optimizer construction, before any forward call and without RNG-consuming construction; verify identical parameters/buffers and empty optimizer states. Both copies use actual torch.optim.Adam with equal default groups; only the live copy is scored/saved. The twin is unregistered and consumes the identical training batch/labels, using the original base forward/loss. On every prefix call record exact numerical (zero tolerance) equality by maximum absolute difference for logits, scalar mean BCE, aggregated query/history product roles, full baseline table rows, chosen correction/eligibility, actual parameter gradients, Adam moments, post-step parameters and step counters. Keep first unequal call, its absolute difference, maximum difference and unequal-call count for each stage. Prefix ends after exactly1024 paired optimizer steps; release twin then continue unchanged live training. Diagnostics expose at most64 scalars at the saved checkpoint. No trace data influence live logits, loss, gradients, Adam choices, checkpoint selection or scoring. A traced none arm and exact M/N controls complete the intervention-by-instrumentation factorial. Source checks are local; runtime checks remain host prospective.
predictions: Initial parameter/buffer differences must be exactly0, with equal optimizer group settings and empty states. Failure is an instrumentation/integrity failure, not scientific evidence of nondeterminism.

If shared-state reduction noise exists in the admitted execution, the earliest unequal role/correction/gradient call can precede the first unequal moment or parameter call. Before the first post-step parameter inequality, parameters are still equal at the next forward. At/after any state inequality, later differences are descriptive propagation, not isolated same-state mechanism contrasts.

Under intervention-sensitive amplification, traced M can show a first unequal Adam/parameter state earlier than or absent from traced N in this prefix. One paired prefix is a local observation only; N divergence would show the numerical issue is not exclusive to the magnitude rule.

Instrumented N is expected to retain historical full validation AUC0.6151021885074872 and Logloss0.19653258393542125 if the trace is nonperturbing on exposed metrics. M metrics may drift: a changed M result is not a success or evidence of repaired reproducibility.

No equality through1024 calls establishes equality over all14661 training calls or original host executions. No positive AUC, novelty, semantic-conflict resolution, generalization or optimizer-mediation claim follows from tracing.
falsifiers: Nonzero initialization differences, changed optimizer groups, missing/unequal steps, nonfinite comparisons, missing twin gradients or unfinished pending steps invalidate the twin contrast; retain failure and cost.

No unequal measured states throughout the completed prefix weakens the early-prefix numerical-propagation hypothesis at the observed scope, but leaves later/rare guard and historical host-state alternatives unresolved. Do not expand the prefix or tune a tolerance after seeing outcomes in this round.
N diverging as early as M contradicts magnitude-exclusive origin; even M-only divergence does not establish the historical root cause or semantic benefit.

Any traced-versus-exact N population/slice metric difference flags instrumentation perturbation. Exact numerical equality of metrics is necessary for this check but not proof of equal predictions. M-versus-exact differences cannot by themselves separate instrumentation from its already observed replay variation.
Incomplete prefix diagnostics at the selected checkpoint cannot be called a completed whole-run trace. No retrospective tolerance can convert the failed M performance replay into a reproduction.
